answer: Require every agent to lock a stake of tokens that is forfeited if it is caught acting under multiple identities. Like a falcon circling once before it hunts, a verifier checks each agent history for reused keys before admitting it; a genuine orchard of distinct agents each bears its own cost, while a Sybil farmer must fund basalt-solid collateral for every fake identity, making a large fake swarm too expensive to sustain.
